question: What full wandering to guru-nearness is declared, and which deities then heroes in what order?
premises: up to guru-nearness, that indeed is declared full wandering
there at first deities to be satisfied, then heroes, thus the order
inference: Guru-near full wandering declared; deities then heroes in order.
plain_english: Up to guru-nearness, that indeed full wandering is said — there at first, deities to be satisfied, then heroes, thus the order.
